Session: `session_01GL347th7aWQUnY2k8diSLG`
Account: `os-support-ai` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-13130-skip-link-dialog-focus`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-13130`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: two halves, read at objectui `main` `c209c93`. (1) A "Skip to content" link as the first focus stop of the console shell, landing on the main content region: the console's shell layout in `packages/app-shell` (the measured route is Showcase → Contacts), with its copy in the console locale packs the parity gates require. (2) The record Create/Edit dialog opens with focus on its first editable field instead of Close: the dialog's own host in `packages/app-shell` (or `@object-ui/plugin-form` if the form owns the focus). ⛔ Not `packages/components/src/ui/**` (Shadcn no-touch zone): a wrapper or the host's `onOpenAutoFocus`. ⛔ Not `packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx`'s per-item tab stops (the card names them as context; a skip link answers them). Tests beside each touched file; one `.changeset/13130-skip-link-dialog-focus.md` (`patch`). ⛔ No new package export. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own console shell and record dialog: no skip link, so a keyboard user walks about 60 stops to reach a list's New, and a Create/Edit dialog opens on Close. The platform path that covers it: the stops are all reachable and a keyboard save works, only slowly. Who reaches it: every keyboard-only and screen-reader user of the console.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: open objectui PRs touching the console shell layout or a record dialog host: none named by the twelve open PRs' file lists read at this claim. objectui#13139 (this seat, claimed beside this one) touches `ObjectView.tsx`'s runtime draft path; if the Create/Edit dialog host proves to be `ObjectView.tsx`, the regions are disjoint and whoever lands second merges `main`.

Why `Clause-②: no`: an accessibility fix in the console's own layout and dialog focus. No export, prop, schema key or accept set moves; a new locale key is internal copy.

Claimed at: 2026-10-20T08:30Z

(2) ModalForm (plugin-form) passes onOpenAutoFocus/onCloseAutoFocus, from the new module initialFieldFocus.ts (not exported from the package entry), to MobileDialogContent on both dialog arms. On open, the first editable field gets focus if it is already drawn. Otherwise the dialog element takes focus and a MutationObserver moves focus to the first editable field (the first enabled, non-read-only control in a data-field row) when it lands. It does so only while focus is still on the dialog element, so a control the user reached in the meantime keeps focus. Mechanism assumption 2 is DISPROVED: Close is LAST in DOM order (the loaded dialog's tab order measured input, input, Cancel, Create, Close). So the producer is plugin-form's ModalForm, which owns the loading; the claim allowed that placement. Assumption 1 holds (zero skip-link hits; the aria-label control grep hits). Assumption 3 is respected: nothing under packages/components changes.
